findings.evidence: Upstream precedent `PowerSeries.coeff_one_substInvOfIsUnit : (P.substInvOfIsUnit hP').coeff 1 = hP'.unit⁻¹` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries/Substitution.lean:583) places the index immediately after `coeff` even though it is the last argument; this PR follows that in `coeff_one_subst` (Substitution.lean:68), `coeff_two_subst` (74), `coeff_three_subst` (81), `coeff_four_subst` (93), `coeff_one_toPowerSeries_inv` (204), and `coeff_one/two/three_toPowerSeries_cubicSchemeChange` (BetaFunction.lean:280,285,290). The `betaCoeff_*` family is the only deviation, and `transformBeta_one` (BetaFunction.lean:121) already binds the trailing-`_one` reading to `F = 1`.
findings.fix: Put the numeral directly after `betaCoeff`, as the PR already does for `coeff`: `betaCoeff_zero_transformBeta`, `betaCoeff_one_transformBeta`, `betaCoeff_two_transformBeta`, `betaCoeff_two_transformBeta_cubicSchemeChange`, `betaCoeff_two_transformBeta_of_coeff_one_eq_one`, etc.
findings.issue: The index of `betaCoeff` is appended at the end of the name, so `_one`/`_two`/`_zero` after `transformBeta` means the coefficient index, while `transformBeta_one` (line 121) uses the same suffix for the group element `F = 1`. `betaCoeff_transformBeta_one` therefore reads as `betaCoeff (transformBeta 1 β) n`. Same in `betaCoeff_transformBeta_zero` (220), `betaCoeff_transformBeta_two` (237), `betaCoeff_transformBeta_zero_of_coeff_one_eq_one` (252), `betaCoeff_transformBeta_one_of_coeff_one_eq_one` (259, which then carries three different meanings of `one`), `betaCoeff_transformBeta_two_of_coeff_one_eq_one` (266), `betaCoeff_transformBeta_cubicSchemeChange_two` (296), `forall_coeff_one_eq_one_betaCoeff_transformBeta_two_eq_iff` (305), and the private lemmas at 161, 178, 196.

summary: Names are otherwise standard and follow upstream PowerSeries.Substitution precedent, but the betaCoeff lemma family puts the coefficient index last, which collides with transformBeta_one (where the trailing numeral is the group element 1) and contradicts the numeral-first pattern the same PR uses everywhere else.
